## Change and motivation

Describe the user-visible outcome and link any related issue. Note changes to isolation, permissions, session ownership, context transfers, or stored/shared data.

## Observable verification

List the exact commands or scenarios exercised and their results. Note anything not verified and why. Use synthetic peers/data rather than real provider credentials or model calls.

## Submission checklist

- [ ] Verification covers the changed behavior, including relevant failure cases.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated, with English, Russian, and Simplified Chinese parity where applicable (or an explanation of why no update is needed).
- [ ] No credentials, authentication files, private prompts, session databases, runtime directories, or other private data are included in changes, logs, screenshots, or attachments.
- [ ] The distribution manifest is current when distribution inputs change.

For security issues, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Flyozzzz/omp-tandem-public/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead of disclosing vulnerability details in a public pull request.
